description: List the SIM cards (eSIMs) already on the signed-in Hungry eSIM account: ICCID, status, data package, expiry, and install link. Use for "my eSIM", "my SIM card", "how much data do I have left", or before topping up a SIM the traveller already owns. Requires connecting the Hungry eSIM account (OAuth) — no API key.
name: my_esims
title: My eSIMs
